title: 軟體使用
description: 各種軟體操作的表達方式

sentences.en: Open the app and sign in with your account.
sentences.zh: 打開 App 並用你的帳號登入。

sentences.en: Don't forget to save your work.
sentences.zh: 別忘了儲存你的工作。

sentences.en: I need to export this file as a PDF.
sentences.zh: 我需要把這個檔案匯出成 PDF。

sentences.en: Can you change the format to JPEG?
sentences.zh: 你可以把格式改成 JPEG 嗎？

sentences.en: Press Ctrl+Z to undo the last action.
sentences.zh: 按 Ctrl+Z 來復原上一步操作。

sentences.en: My subscription expires next month.
sentences.zh: 我的訂閱下個月到期。

sentences.en: I can't log in to my account.
sentences.zh: 我無法登入我的帳號。

sentences.en: The software needs to be updated to the latest version.
sentences.zh: 這個軟體需要更新到最新版本。

sentences.en: I imported the data from an Excel spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 我從 Excel 試算表匯入了資料。

sentences.en: You can customize the toolbar to your preference.
sentences.zh: 你可以自訂工具列符合你的喜好。

sentences.en: The free trial only lasts for seven days.
sentences.zh: 免費試用期只有七天。

sentences.en: I synced my files across all devices.
sentences.zh: 我把檔案同步到所有裝置了。

sentences.en: Click on 'File' and then select 'Print'.
sentences.zh: 點「檔案」然後選「列印」。

sentences.en: I forgot to log out of my account.
sentences.zh: 我忘記登出帳號了。

sentences.en: This app requires a paid subscription.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 需要付費訂閱。

sentences.en: I enabled two-factor authentication for security.
sentences.zh: 我為了安全啟用了雙重驗證。

sentences.en: You can redo the action with Ctrl+Y.
sentences.zh: 你可以用 Ctrl+Y 來重做操作。

sentences.en: The document is in read-only mode.
sentences.zh: 這份文件是唯讀模式。

sentences.en: I merged the two documents into one.
sentences.zh: 我把兩份文件合併成一份了。

sentences.en: The app crashed when I tried to open it.
sentences.zh: 我試著打開時，App 就當掉了。

sentences.en: I added a filter to the spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 我在試算表加了一個篩選條件。

sentences.en: Can you resize the image before uploading?
sentences.zh: 你可以在上傳前調整圖片大小嗎？

sentences.en: I use cloud storage to keep my files safe.
sentences.zh: 我用雲端儲存來保護我的檔案。

sentences.en: The plugin is not compatible with this version.
sentences.zh: 這個外掛跟這個版本不相容。

sentences.en: I shared the document with editing permissions.
sentences.zh: 我分享了文件並給予編輯權限。

sentences.en: You need to verify your email address first.
sentences.zh: 你需要先驗證你的電子郵件地址。

sentences.en: I reset my password through the app.
sentences.zh: 我透過 App 重設了密碼。

sentences.en: The auto-save feature is really convenient.
sentences.zh: 自動儲存功能真的很方便。

sentences.en: I created a new template for the report.
sentences.zh: 我為報告建立了一個新範本。

sentences.en: Make sure you select the correct output format.
sentences.zh: 確保你選擇了正確的輸出格式。
